authors: François J. Meunier and Marc Herbin
title: La collection de préparations histologiques effectuées par Paul Gervais (1816-1879) sur le squelette des “poissons”

authors: Thomas Schmid, Robert Jungnickel, Birger Neuhaus, Jens Riedel, Janina Kneipp, and Carsten Lüter
title: Raman spectroscopy as a tool for the collection management of microscope slides
citation: Thomas Schmid, Robert Jungnickel, Birger Neuhaus, Jens Riedel, Janina Kneipp, and Carsten Lüter, “Raman spectroscopy as a tool for the collection management of microscope slides,” Zoologischer Anzeiger 265 (2016): 178–190.

authors: Birger Neuhaus, Thomas Schmid, and Jens Riedel
title: Collection management and study of microscope slides: Storage, profiling, deterioration, restoration procedures, and general recommendations
citation: Birger Neuhaus, Thomas Schmid, and Jens Riedel, “Collection management and study of microscope slides: Storage, profiling, deterioration, restoration procedures, and general recommendations,” Zootaxa 4322, no. 1 (2017): 1–173.
tags: conservation; mounting media; restoration; bibliography; collections

title: La colección histórica de esponjas del Museo Nacional de Ciencias Naturales (MNCN.CSIC): 1771–1939
citation: J. I. Sánchez-Almazán, “La colección histórica de esponjas del Museo Nacional de Ciencias Naturales (MNCN.CSIC): 1771–1939,” Graellsia 73, no. 2 (2017): e060.
